guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 查看 kPoints 余额
guide.description: 打开 kPoints 仪表盘，连接此前用于质押或交易的钱包。最终余额包含 10 月 1 日的分配。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Open the kPoints dashboard and connect the wallet you used for staking or trading. Your final balance includes the October 1 distribution.

guide.title: 为购买准备钱包资金
guide.description: 领取每枚 KNTQ 需支付 0.26 美元，因此同一钱包中需要足够的稳定币支付所选数量，另需少量 HYPE 支付 HyperEVM 手续费。转入资金前，先核对领取页接受哪种支付资产。原文提供了在 Bybit 购买 USDC 并提到钱包的选项；其他链上的资金可通过来源页面下方组件兑换或跨链至 Hyperliquid。原文还包含组件宣传：支持 30 多条链，宣称路由快速、费用较低；点击立即跨链（Bridge now）打开组件，也可在新标签页打开。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_title: Fund Your Wallet for the Purchase
guide.original_description: The claim costs $0.26 per KNTQ, so the same wallet needs enough stablecoins to cover the amount you want, plus a little HYPE for gas on HyperEVM. Check which payment asset the claim page accepts before moving funds. If you need USDC, you can buy it on Bybit and withdraw it to your wallet. Already holding funds on another chain? Swap or bridge them to Hyperliquid with the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 打开 KNTQ 领取页面
guide.description: 打开 Kinetiq 网站的 KNTQ 页面，连接持有 kPoints 的钱包，查看获配数量。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the KNTQ page on the Kinetiq site and connect the wallet that holds your kPoints to see your allocation.

guide.title: 确认购买 KNTQ
guide.description: 核对 KNTQ 数量及按每枚 0.26 美元计算的总费用，然后在钱包中确认交易。需要在 2026 年 10 月 1 日起的 10 天内完成此步骤。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Review the KNTQ amount and the total cost at $0.26 per token, then approve the transaction in your wallet. You have 10 days from October 1, 2026 to complete this step.

guide.title: 质押 KNTQ 获取 sKNTQ（可选）
guide.description: 在同一页面质押以获得 sKNTQ，可分享协议回购收益。持有至少 2,500,000 sKNTQ，还可将 Markets 邀请奖励比例从 10% 提升至 15%。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Stake on the same page to receive sKNTQ, which earns a share of protocol buybacks. Holding 2,500,000 sKNTQ or more also raises your Markets referral rate from 10% to 15%.

sourcedDescription: The second kPoints program ran from November 13, 2025 to September 29, 2026, distributing 800,000 kPoints every week. The final distribution landed on October 1, 2026, bringing the total to 36,800,000 kPoints. Those points now give holders the right to buy KNTQ at a fixed price rather than receive it for free.
tagline_en: The second kPoints program ran from November 13, 2025 to September 29, 2026, distributing 800,000 kPoints every week. The final distribution landed on October 1, 2026, bringing the total to 36,800,000 kPoints. Those points now give holders the right to buy KNTQ at a fixed price rather than receive it for free.
